name: POLS 3019W
title: Black Political Thought
description: Exploration of black U.S., Caribbean, and African political thought, with a focus on processes of and resistance to racialization, enslavement, and colonization.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011, open to juniors or higher. Recommended preparation: POLS 1002 and AFRA 2211.
